title.en: An Act to Amend Section One of Act Numbered Twenty-Five Hundred and One, in the Sense that the Present Vocales of the Provincial Hoard, Formerly third Members, Shall Be Called "Vocales of the Provincial Board," and that the Members Appointed By the Governor-General Shall Be Elective.

text.en:
Section one of Act Numbered Twenty-five hundred and one is hereby amended to read as
"Section 1. Until otherwise provided by law, provincial, treasurers of provinces organized under Act
Numbered Eighty-three, entitled 'The Provincial Government Act,' shall cease to be members of provincial
boards, and in lieu thereof there shall remain as such members the third members which in future shall be
known as 'vocales of the provincial board.' In lieu of the third members the position of a new member of the
provincial board is created, who shall be known as 'vocal' and shall be elected in the same form and manner
as the provincial governors. This new member shall perform duties similar to those of the former ; third
members and shall receive the same per diem as the 'vocales of the provincial board' and be entitled to the
reimbursement of his actual and necessary traveling expenses, in case he is not a resident of the provincial
capital, payable from provincial funds."

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 4, 1916.
